SELECT customer_id, order_count, CAST(order_count AS DECIMAL(19,10)) / total_orders AS order_share
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) AS total_orders
  FROM Orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
) AS customer_orders
ORDER BY order_share DESC
LIMIT 10;
